supporting_features.feature_phrase: abrupt lateral offset at a horizontal boundary
supporting_features.evidence: The printed outline changes sideways at a distinct height rather than continuing vertically from the section below.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: upper section displaced relative to the base
supporting_features.evidence: The upper printed mass is visibly translated sideways from the lower footprint.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: projecting ledge at the offset interface
supporting_features.evidence: One side of the displaced section extends beyond the wall below, forming a pronounced horizontal ledge.

supporting_features.feature_phrase: recessed step opposite the projecting edge
supporting_features.evidence: The opposing side shows an inward step where the upper and lower outer contours no longer align.
